body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung displayed ''SCH-B540'' 14.9mm clamshell S-DMB mobile phone dubbed as ''Slim & H''. It features 16,000,000 color 2.15-inch QVGA TFT-LCD, black GUI, dual speaker, external mp3 touch keypad, VOD/MOD service, and TV-out. It also has 2M rotating camera that is capable of taking picture automatically after 3 seconds, which might be useful for taking picture of oneself. Other features include file viewer, Bluetooth connectivity, and playing with my pet.
